> All dates are plain years. Year 0 = start of the Mortal Kingdoms era.
> Year 500 = Present (campaign start). Negative numbers = before Year 0.
> Event IDs are stable references (E01-E92 range; some IDs may be unused).
> Entities may link to specific
> events via these IDs in their `related` field (e.g. "timeline E38: Sealing of Khar'Zul").

## Visibility Legend
- [PUBLIC] = player-facing, known in-world
- [SECRET] = GM-only, hidden from players
- [PUBLIC MYTH - FALSE] = publicly known but factually false (misdirection)
- [SECRET - TRUE] = hidden truth, contradicts the public myth

---

# Primordial Times (Before Year 0)

## E01 - The 3 Originals
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Cosmic
- **Description**: The 3 Originals (A, B, C) appear into existence as a result of the universe trying to understand itself.

## E02 - Originals create Everything
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Creation
- **Description**: True Creation. Originals give shape to everything: time, space, matter; planes, worlds, continents; monsters, creatures, beings; cycles, order, chaos; consciousness, rationality, feelings. Accidental byproduct: free will.

## E03 - The Great Reset
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: A and C see free will as unacceptable. They plan a Great Reset -- full genocide of all self-aware, conscious species capable of prayer and faith. B sees this as cruel and disagrees.

## E04 - B's Sacrifice
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Cosmic
- **Description**: B foresaw the genocidal plans. B manifests Magic into existence -- sacrificing their full cosmic existence. Arcane Energy spreads through all existence, along with currency metals and gemstones on solid ground. The sacrifice also implements a protective effect on all planes for 100 years, impeding direct influence from an Original source.

## E05 - Protection of B's Sacrifice
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Protection
- **Timeframe**: Year -5 to Year 100
- **Description**: B's protection effect duration. The shield prevents the other 2 Originals from interfering directly with mortal development for 100 years.

---

# The Age of Creation (Before Year 0)

## E06 - A & C Subdivide into 10 Gods
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: Unable to interfere on any plane for 100 years, A and C proceed with plotting. They sub-divide their own essence into 10 gods, planning to use prayer, faith, and worship from mortals to restore spent power, expand beyond current limits, and enjoy fooling mortal races on a massive scale.

## E07 - The Plans of the Gods
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: The gods begin scheming their manipulation of mortals: control through religion, harvest of faith, division among mortals, action from shadows.

## E08 - Birth of The Gods
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Cosmic
- **Description**: The 10 Gods come into existence -- 10 omnipotent entities coming into an empty canvas of reality. (Public knows the gods exist; the truth of their origin from A and C is hidden.)

## E09 - Creation Myth
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC MYTH - FALSE]
- **Category**: Public Religion
- **Description**: The fabricated creation story: Kaelthor shaped the world, Aurelius imposed order, Vesper introduced peace, Aloria brought light, Tyra instilled hunger, Raven Queen completed death, Thalkis taught forge and arcane, Crassian introduced currency, Vorn granted war, Lolth provided wit. **This never happened.** The gods fabricated this narrative to obscure the Originals.

---

# The Mortal Kingdoms (Year 0 - 100)

## E10 - The Mortal Kingdoms Era Begins
- **Year**: 0
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Era
- **Description**: Thriving of mortal kingdoms. During the first 100 years of existence, six Mortal Kingdoms were established and thrived -- each founded by a common mortal race (Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Halflings, Gnomes, Half-Orcs) in their ancestral regions, with peaceful and friendly relations between them. Uncommon races had no kingdom; they grouped together in large villages.

## E11 - Mortal Kingdoms Founded
- **Year**: 3
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Construction
- **Description**: Six kingdoms established by each common race in their ancestral regions, each with its own capital city:
  - **Kingdom of Drakhaven** (Humans) -- self-styled "capital of Kythoria", largest and most advanced city
  - **Kingdom of Elyndor** (Elves) -- ancient forest capital of arcane knowledge; territory included the Verdant Reaches
  - **Kingdom of Kazadur** (Dwarves) -- mountain-forge capital of unmatched craftsmanship in the northeast; its mines produced all currency metals and gemstones
  - **Kingdom of Hearthglen** (Halflings) -- pastoral agricultural heartland and trade stop; home of the royal mint; halflings were the continent's perfect accountants
  - **Kingdom of Everquill** (Gnomes) -- scholarly capital of law, records, and maps; the paper capital of the mortal kingdoms
  - **Kingdom of Stonefist** (Half-Orcs) -- rugged fortress capital of proud warriors
  Trade routes (Crassian's Dust Circle) began to form between the kingdoms. Raw metals from Kazadur were shipped to Hearthglen for minting and distribution.

## E12 - Crassian's Dust Circle Established
- **Year**: 13
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Trade
- **Description**: Ancient overland trade route connecting the great kingdoms of old. Each species inhabited their own realm, and the route connected them all. Named after the great clouds of dust raised by caravans crossing the continent.

## E13 - Churches Established
- **Year**: 18
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Religion
- **Description**: Churches for all gods are established. The gods begin harvesting faith (which makes them stronger).

## E14 - Drakh Ix'thar Guild Founded
- **Year**: 74 to 134
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Founding
- **Description**: Drakh Ix'thar Guild (The Great Dragon Hunt) Monster Hunting Guild established and flourished. HQ in the old capital. Members called Ix'thari. It suspended activities after the central capital of Kythoria was lost to the invading monster army.

---

# The Abominable End (Year 100 - 300)

## E15 - B's Protection Ends
- **Year**: 100
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Cosmic
- **Description**: The 100-year protection shield fades. A and C can now act through their god-fragments.

## E16 - Planar Breaches Open
- **Year**: 100
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Disaster
- **Description**: Planar breaches along Kythoria's coast start to appear. Monster hordes pour forth. Few know this is the source of the monsters. The gods orchestrated the opening.

## E17 - The Undying Scourge War
- **Year**: 100 to 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: Hordes upon hordes of monstrosities keep appearing and pouring from the shores inward. No one knows where they come from, what they want, or why they won't stop. The war spans centuries.

## E18 - The Five Generals Emerge
- **Year**: 126
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: A fourth of the continent has fallen. Death toll is in the tens of millions -- around 15% of the population is dead. Five figureheads emerge behind the dread monster army. Their names and origins remain unknown to the general public.
- **Secret**: One of the five was Khar'Zul, an ancient Ulrath from the Nine Hells. The other four remain undefined.
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]

## E19 - B's Crystals Affect Monster Army
- **Year**: 129 to 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: Monster army progressively gives in to the influence of the B Crystals. The hoarding instinct subverts the army's genocidal mission.

## E20 - Drakh Ix'thar Guild Suspends Activities
- **Year**: 134
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Disbandment
- **Description**: The Guild is forced to suspend its activities due to the capital and central HQ of the Guild being lost to the monster invasion.

## E21 - Monster Army Progress - Half Continent
- **Year**: 162
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: Half of the continent is now under dominion of the monster army. Around 40% of the population is either dead or enslaved -- free labor and free food for the monsters.

## E22 - Crystal Influence: 20%
- **Year**: 166
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: 1/5th of the monster's army is now manifesting average to severe symptoms of the hoarding compulsion sickness. Affected entities are weaker creatures, foot soldiers, and small unit leaders.

## E23 - Monster Army Fully Deployed
- **Year**: 170
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Migration
- **Description**: All monster army military units have finished being deployed. The planar breaches are closed at this point.

## E24 - The First Alliance is Established
- **Year**: 192 to 500 (ongoing)
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Founding
- **Description**: Kings, archmages, high priests, monster hunters, and knightly orders unite. Decisions: organize defense using all resources from all capitals, create fortified cities, research arcane barrier, research how to defeat the Generals. The Alliance never formally dissolved and continues as the governing body to the present day.

## E25 - Gods Discover B-Crystal Influence
- **Year**: 202
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: Gods discover the hoarding instinct subverting monsters from genocide. They issue new directives: destroy hoarding nests, destroy large currency accumulations, destroy large magical item accumulations, destroy any B-crystal found.

## E26 - Monster Army Progress Slows
- **Year**: 202
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: Monster army progress was swift at first: 50% of the continent conquered in the first 62 years. From then, progress stalled. It took about 40 more years to get to ~65% of the continent. 60% of the population is now dead or enslaved.

## E27 - Crystal Influence: 45%
- **Year**: 202
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: ~2/5th of the monster's army is now manifesting moderate to severe symptoms of the hoarding compulsion. Those previously infected (20%) are now totally under the influence. Lieutenants and Captains affected -- army loses about 1/3rd of its strength.

## E28 - Monster Army Scattered
- **Year**: 232
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: Army's pace is extremely slow compared to the initial invasion. ~75% of the continent controlled. 70% of mortal races individuals are gone. (Public sees the scattering; the crystal influence cause is hidden.)

## E29 - Crystal Influence: 60%
- **Year**: 232
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: 60% of the monster's army is now manifesting moderate to severe symptoms of the hoarding compulsion. ~2/3rd of the army's strength is lost.

## E30 - General Deserts to Hoarding
- **Year**: 238
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: One of the five generals deserts the army's chain of command, succumbing to the Crystal's hoarding compulsion. His entire division (around 30% of the army) is completely lost. They establish a nest on the most north-west capital -- the place most probable for the ritual to take place.

## E31 - General Goes Missing
- **Year**: 238
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Mystery
- **Description**: One of the 5 Great generals stops being spotted by the First Alliance intel gathering teams. No sign of them, no one knows where they went. Last seen moving NW from the capital.

## E32 - The Last Stand is Founded
- **Year**: 268
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Founding
- **Description**: Three capitals are established: Skywatch, Emberforge, Weaveheart. These become the final strongholds of mortal civilization.

## E33 - Crystal Influence: 80%
- **Year**: 270
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: One full division is under the Crystal's hoarding influence. The other 4 have lost around 70% of their forces. The mortal army feels the progressive weakening of the monster's army, unaware of the true cause.

## E34 - Mortal Races in Danger of Extinction
- **Year**: 270
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Crisis
- **Description**: 90% of the continent has fallen. 80% of the continent's population is no more. The survivors are all gathered at the Last Stand. Situation is extremely dire, hope is all but lost, extinction seems a growing certainty.

## E35 - Arcane Barrier Operational
- **Year**: 273
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Science
- **Description**: The arcane barrier protecting the Last Stand becomes operational. The Thormvuld family led the research, first developed in Weaveheart at a ley line convergence, then expanded to all three capitals.

## E36 - Defeat of Voragos
- **Year**: 279
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Battle
- **Description**: **Voragos, the Ashen Winged Eclipse** — the ancient black dragon general commanding the Ashen Legion — is slain in the bloodiest battle of the Scourge War. His death marks the first time a Great General has fallen, proving the First Alliance can defeat even the monster army's greatest commanders.

## E37 - Defeat of Xerathul
- **Year**: 284
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Battle
- **Description**: **Xerathul, the Veiled Eyes of Death** — the Lich general commanding the Grave Legion — is hunted down and destroyed by the First Alliance. His death deprives the monster army of its necromantic backbone; the undead legions that grew stronger with every battle finally collapse. The dracolich he raised is later captured by U.D.A.R.U. for necromantic research.

## E38 - Sealing of Khar'Zul
- **Year**: 296
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Battle
- **Description**: Khar'Zul's physical form is destroyed, but his essence endures. His own sword (having absorbed his blood, victories, and hatred) becomes the only vessel. The greatest sealing ritual binds Khar'Zul within the blade. The blade is entrusted to the Skallfang Clan.

## E39 - Kha'Thuun Goes into Hiding
- **Year**: 298
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Disbandment
- **Description**: **Kha'Thuun, the Witness from Beyond** — the mind flayer general commanding the Black Legion — vanishes without a trace. The last of the Five Great Generals to remain active, his disappearance marks the end of coordinated monster army command. Some speculate he went into hiding, others that he died, others that he returned to his home plane. Never defeated, never found.
## E66 - Khel'vin Born
- **Year**: 290
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Birth
- **Description**: Khel'vin is born to a blue dragon mother and a white dragon father in the mountains of Kythoria. His mother is the same blue dragon whose skeleton would later rest in the Azure Boneyard. His father's status is unknown.

---

# The Rise of Mortals (Year 300 - 500)

## E86 - Crystal Influence: 90%
- **Year**: 300
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Crystal Influence
- **Description**: Influence status: 90%. Most of the monster army has succumbed to the hoarding compulsion. They make nests, create basic dungeons with traps, and defend their ground against mortal forces attempting to reconquer. Unbeknown to mortals, the monsters are not fighting to keep the continent and end mortals like they were initially -- they now fight to keep their nests and their piles of treasure, under B's spreading influence.

## E40 - Crimson Covenant Created
- **Year**: 300 to 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Researchers running experiments with Khar'zul's blade become corrupted by his influence and whispers. They disappear with sealing fragments, the blade, and forbidden knowledge, establishing the secret organization: the Crimson Covenant. Their purpose: research, develop, and refine control over Khar'Zul, believing he is the true eternal divinity since nothing can kill him.

## E41 - The Reconquering Begins
- **Year**: 300 to 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: War
- **Description**: Under the leadership of the First Alliance, using the military and arcane technological superiority offered by the Last Stand, an army is founded to start the reconquering of the continent: the Last Line Army.

## E42 - First B-Crystal Sample Obtained
- **Year**: 302
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: The Crimson Covenant obtains the first sample of a B-crystal, which they research thoroughly. Experiments with the Crystal and Khar'Zul produce interesting results -- Khar'Zul seems to succumb to an influence driving gathering of money, gemstones, and magical items.

## E43 - Drow Elfs Created (Public Myth)
- **Year**: 303
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC MYTH - FALSE]
- **Category**: Public Race
- **Description**: Public story: Lolth creates the Drow Elfs. **This is false** -- the true origin is the Crimson Covenant's Project Genesis (see E44).

## E44 - Drow Elfs Created (True Origin)
- **Year**: 303
- **Visibility**: [SECRET - TRUE]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Drow Elfs are a byproduct of Project Genesis. Elven subjects grafted with demonic tissue from Khar'zul's sealed blade survived with sunlight sensitivity and fled to the Underdark.

## E45 - Drow Become Known to Mortal Races
- **Year**: 308
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Discovery
- **Description**: Little is known about the Drow, where their settlement is, or how to get there. Reports speak of a gargantuan black willow tree present in the forest, said to be cursed, along with Abyssal nightmarish creatures that guard the area. Mortals conclude Lolth created these new Elfs.

## E46 - Drow Establish the Underdark
- **Year**: 308
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Settlement
- **Description**: The Drow Elfs establish a working society in a large settlement to the west of the continent. A large Black Willow, with branches and leaves reaching the ground in the shape of a multi-leg spider, blocks all sunlight from the skies above. In the settlement, there is a rift to the Abyssal plane.

## E47 - Covenant Discovers the Divine Lie
- **Year**: 311
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: The Crimson Covenant starts uncovering the Divine Lie: Arcane Energy exists on all planes regardless of gods; gods do not provide it; crystals influence monsters with hoarding behavior; crystals contain part of the consciousness of an entity that pre-dates the gods; crystals resonate with Arcane Energy and currency metals; crystals, currency metals, and gemstones were all created around the same time.

## E48 - Covenant Blackmails the Gods
- **Year**: 313
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: After being hunted for 2 years, the Crimson Covenant develops an arcane device as a failsafe. All higher echelon members must maintain a connection to it. If even one connection goes down for more than a minute, all combined knowledge of the upper echelon will be automatically and telepathically distributed to every rational individual of every mortal race on every plane. The blackmail works -- deaths of Covenant members drop.

## E49 - Gods Discover Resurrection Ritual
- **Year**: 314
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: From keeping an eye on the Crimson Covenant, the Gods discover the Resurrection Ritual, and that B can be brought back -- even at different power levels, possibly an entity stronger than themselves. Their greatest fear.

## E50 - Resurrection Ritual Theory Discovered
- **Year**: 314
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Faced with ultimate existential pressure from the Divine, the Covenant shifts their goal: still bring Khar'Zul back, but now use him to bring back B with a power level strong enough to destroy the Gods. Requirements: a runic system carved in valuable currency metals, using B-crystals, consuming all arcane energy, metals, and items within a 3-mile radius. Outcome scales with materials provided (from small wisp to cosmic presence).

## E51 - Shadow Elfs Created (Public Myth)
- **Year**: 339
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC MYTH - FALSE]
- **Category**: Public Race
- **Description**: Public story: the Raven Queen creates the Shadar-Kai ("Shadow kissed elfs"), known as Shadow Elfs. **This is false** -- the true origin is the Crimson Covenant's Project Genesis (see E52).

## E52 - Shadow Elfs Created (True Origin)
- **Year**: 339
- **Visibility**: [SECRET - TRUE]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Shadow Elfs are a byproduct of Project Genesis. Elven subjects whose transformation attuned them to the Shadowfell, where they fled.

## E53 - Shadar-Kai Establish Shadowfell
- **Year**: 344
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Settlement
- **Description**: The Shadow Elfs establish a settlement, location unknown to other mortal races though the general area is known. The settlement receives the name "Shadowfell" -- where the shadows fell to. It has a direct connection to the Shadowfell Plane.

## E54 - Bloodline Tracking Begins
- **Year**: 377
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: The Crimson Covenant stops taking random individuals and focuses on establishing seats of power, tracking specific individual bloodlines, and becoming more selective about who they take and spend resources on.

## E55 - Tieflings Created
- **Year**: 413
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Crimson Covenant experiments use fragments of living flesh from Khar'zul's sealed blade, grafting demonic tissue onto living human subjects. Most perish in days, some lose their minds, few reject the transplant. Survivors become the first Tieflings.

## E56 - Perfect Vessel Engineered
- **Year**: 458
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: The perfect carrier for Khar'Zul is born, created through careful genetic selection and forceful breeding -- the woman who would become Balor's mother. Her demonic resistance is unmatched; she can be in the presence of the blade without side effects.

## E57 - Balor is Conceived
- **Year**: 479
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: At 21, Balor's mother is classified as ready for fertilization. A small tissue graft of Khar'zul enveloped in a scrap of her own skin is attached to her womb.

## E58 - Balor is Born
- **Year**: 480
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: Balor is born -- a healthy baby tiefling that the blade is naturally attuned to. With her 3 month old baby, Balor's mother escapes the facility, leaves Balor in a zone known to barbarian tribes, and scatters to the winds. She is never heard from again.
## E67 - Khel'vin Masters Cold Breath
- **Year**: 400
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Training
- **Description**: Khel'vin fully masters Cold Breath, a freezing exhalation learned from his white dragon father. This ability would later prove critical in the battle against the Air Elemental in the Cavern of Discovery.

## E68 - Khel'vin Attacked by Divine Agent
- **Year**: 486
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: Khel'vin discovers fragments of the truth about the gods' conspiracy -- that the monster invasion was orchestrated. A divine agent triggers a massive rockslide to silence him. Khel'vin survives but is permanently crippled (impaired flight, one eye lost).

## E69 - Nyra Born
- **Year**: 480
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Birth
- **Description**: Nyra is born to two genasi ranger parents in the mountain region. Her parents are researchers investigating the connection between the four elemental planes and the Material Plane's creation.

## E70 - Nyra's Parents Disappear
- **Year**: 486
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Mystery
- **Description**: Nyra's genasi ranger parents vanish without a trace. Their elemental convergence research, encrypted in manuscripts and riddles, is left with Ghavel for safekeeping. The Crimson Covenant is suspected of involvement. Nyra (age 6) wakes to find them gone.

## E71 - Nyra Finds Khel'vin; Essence Resonance
- **Year**: 486
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Bonding
- **Description**: Lost 6-year-old Nyra finds Khel'vin, wounded and pinned under tons of rock. Their air essences resonate -- Khel'vin absorbs Nyra's essence to gain strength and lifts the rocks. He agrees to help find her parents. They search for one year with no success.

## E72 - Nyra Gives Up Search; Raised by Khel'vin
- **Year**: 487
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Upbringing
- **Description**: Age 7. Nyra stops searching for her parents. Khel'vin becomes her guardian and teacher. He trains her in hunting, tracking, and wilderness survival. Nyra begins selling hunted goods in the city to support them.

## E73 - Nyra Receives Mystery Box from Ghavel
- **Year**: 498
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Mystery
- **Description**: On her 18th birthday, Nyra receives her parents' mystery box from Ghavel at Moonlight Alley. Contents: encrypted manuscripts, riddles, photographs with traces erased, a smaller locked box. Nyra learns her parents had a city house she never knew about.

## E74 - Nyra Deciphers Encrypted Journal
- **Year**: 499
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Discovery
- **Description**: Nyra spends a week in her parents' city house deciphering the encrypted journal. Discovers reference to four elementals (Air, Fire, Water, Earth) whose soul fragments must be collected.

## E75 - Nyra Defeats Air Elemental; Essence Awakens
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Awakening
- **Description**: In the Cavern of Discovery, Nyra (age 20) battles the Air Elemental with Khel'vin. Her air genasi essence awakens mid-battle. Khel'vin uses Cold Breath. Nyra collects the Air Elemental Soul Crystal. Khel'vin and Nyra part ways.
## E77 - Kaelyn Born
- **Year**: 350
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Birth
- **Description**: Kaelyn is born in the Underdark to House Velkyn, the ruling Drow house. Twin sister Solyn is born with her. The Twin Omen hangs over them from birth.

## E78 - Trial of Lolth; Kaelyn Exiled
- **Year**: 361
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Trial
- **Description**: At age 11, Kaelyn faces the Trial of Lolth against twin sister Solyn. After five challenges, Kaelyn refuses to kill Seraphine (her tiefling nanny) in the final trial. Solyn kills Seraphine instead. Kaelyn is exiled from the Underdark, wounded and alone.

## E79 - Kaelyn's Azure Boneyard Awakening
- **Year**: 365
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Awakening
- **Description**: At age 15, fleeing Drow scouts, Kaelyn falls through a fissure into the Azure Boneyard. She touches a blue dragon skeleton saturated with B's essence. A bolt of electrical energy surges through her -- her heart externalizes into a red pulsing crystal, her left eye turns black, her hair turns black.

## E80 - Kaelyn Escapes Imprisonment
- **Year**: 400
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Escape
- **Description**: After 20 years of imprisonment and torture by her mother Lyndale Velkyn, Kaelyn escapes during a failed experiment. She releases a massive electrical discharge, pushes Lyndale into a fire, and flees through the Mountain Passage. Solyn pushes Kaelyn to safety but is buried in the cave-in. Kaelyn believes both are dead.

## E81 - Odessa Merikh Born
- **Year**: 422
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Birth
- **Description**: Odessa is born from violence -- the product of a rape committed by elven general Valen Healoris during a raid on a human village. Her mother leaves her in a basket on the border of elven lands. She is found and adopted by Satriya and Eryx Merikh.

## E82 - The Merikh Cabin Attack
- **Year**: 435
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Murder
- **Description**: On Odessa's 13th birthday, Valen Healoris leads an elven strike team to the Merikh cabin in the woods. Satriya's runic barrier is destroyed. Eryx and Satriya are tortured and killed. Odessa survives hidden in an alcove for three days before being found by Rhael of the Venom-Weavers.

## E83 - Zan (Vaelis Zandorian) Born
- **Year**: 471
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Birth
- **Description**: Zan is born Vaelis Zandorian in the Shadowfell shadow-city to Ashura Zando and Athena Orion. He is of the noble Zandorion bloodline of the Shadar-kai.

## E84 - Zan Marked and Exiled
- **Year**: 478
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: At age 7, the Raven Queen's brand manifests on Zan, marking him as a direct bloodline descendant. His parents secretly abandon him on the Material Plane to protect him from jealous noble families. The orphan Dun'vis is groomed to replace him. Zan's memory is magically modified.

## E85 - Zan's Teleportation Awakens
- **Year**: 482
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Awakening
- **Description**: At age 11, during a failed mission, Zan jumps from a 30-ft cliff. In despair he prays for help. The Raven Queen answers -- his innate Shadar-kai teleportation awakens. J.B. witnesses this and sells him to the Flesh Architects, the Crimson Covenant's research division, as Subject 242.

## E87 - Zan Escapes the Flesh Architects
- **Year**: 484
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Escape
- **Description**: At age 13, during a Catalyst Project experiment, Zan teleports out of his restraints, kills a guard and a scientist, and flees. Cornered on the top floor, he jumps from a 100-ft window. A B Crystal shard from the experiments serves as a teleportation anchor. He survives and escapes into the city.
## E88 - Kaelyn's First Surface Village Visit
- **Year**: 380
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Discovery
- **Description**: At age 30, Kaelyn visits a surface village for the first time -- her first contact with the outside world in 19 years of isolation since the Azure Boneyard awakening.

## E90 - Trial of the Fang
- **Year**: 498
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Trial
- **Description**: At age 18, Balor faces the Skallfang Clan's ancient rite of passage alone in the frozen wilderness. When a monster threatens his hunting party, he embraces the Rage -- his horns grow, eyes ignite, claws lengthen, crimson veins spread. He never loses control. Hrothgar bestows the byname: Balor, The Tainted.

## E91 - The Awakening; Skallfang Village Destroyed
- **Year**: 499
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Battle
- **Description**: A Nalfeshnee fiend, sent by the Crimson Covenant, strikes the Skallfang village. Hrothgar dies defending the lodge. Balor grabs Khar'zul's blade and enters the Avatar of the Living Prison state for the first time. The fiend and much of the village are destroyed. Balor collapses unconscious amid the aftermath.

## E92 - Balor Goes into Exile
- **Year**: 499
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Exile
- **Description**: Realizing the Crimson Covenant will keep hunting him and endangering the Skallfang Clan, Balor swears at Hrothgar's grave to find the truth. He slings Khar'zul's blade across his back and disappears into the wilderness.

---

# Current Era (Year 500 - Present)

## E59 - CAMPAIGN START
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Present
- **Description**: The campaign begins. All events at Year 500 define the world state at the start of play.

## E60 - Thormvuld Family Discovers Magical Crystals
- **Year**: 493
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Discovery
- **Description**: House Thormvuld discovers magical crystals of unknown origin in a cavern beneath Seidga'ard. The crystals have a never-before-seen arcane signature -- primal, ancient, familiar. They use them to build the floating island.

## E93 - The Heist on Seidga'ard  --  Intel Gathering Party
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Heist
- **Description**: The first sub-party (Zan, Aurora, Bardolemeu) infiltrated House Thormvuld's floating estate Seidga'ard disguised as catering staff. They gathered intel on defenses, the Aegis Grid, and discovered the existence of an underground research facility conducting experiments with unidentified magical crystals.

## E94 - The Heist on Seidga'ard  --  Extraction Party
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Heist
- **Description**: The second sub-party (Odessa, Zan, Kaelyn, Balor), posing as diplomats of the recently formed Dark Alliance between the Drow and Shadow Elves, infiltrated Seidga'ard during its grand gala. They reached the underground research facility and the ancient Core Cave, extracting crystal samples, prototype Tuning Cylinders, and levitation engine schematics. An optional vault heist recovered additional assets.

## E95 - FX Arranges Payment
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Heist
- **Description**: FX receives all stolen intel, samples, cylinders, and schematics from the party. He arranges to sell stolen art and ancient relics from the heist, paying the extraction party later from those proceeds. He reveals the mission was commissioned by a rival merchant guild from another continent.

## E96 - Thormvuld Family Hunts the Party
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Pursuit
- **Description**: The Thormvuld family mobilizes resources to recover the stolen blueprints and B-crystal samples. They understand that if the levitation technology spreads, their competitive advantage in magical manufacturing and future logistics collapses. The party is now actively hunted.

## E97 - Crimson Covenant Takes Interest
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Pursuit
- **Description**: Word of B-crystals being stolen in the heist reaches the Crimson Covenant. They have been studying B-crystals for nearly 200 years (since E42, 302 YA). The Covenant sees the theft as both a threat (Crystals loose in the wild) and an opportunity (trace the Crystals to find more B-touched subjects, or learn who else seeks B's essence). They begin mobilizing agents to track the party.

## E61 - Crystals' Existence Becomes Public
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Discovery
- **Description**: Reports, whispers, and gossip start circulating of a new kind of crystal discovered by the Thormvuld family, and that they used it to build the floating island. It is also said a 2-party group engineered and pulled off a heist on the floating island. The Family say nothing too valuable was stolen.

## E62 - Monster Army Holds 1/4 of Continent
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Military
- **Description**: After invasion and reconquering, the Monster Army still holds 1/4 of the continent.

## E63 - The Reconquering Endures
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [PUBLIC]
- **Category**: Military
- **Description**: Three-quarters of the continent has now been reconquered. Hardest contest is on the North and North-West. The Center Capital, South, and West zones have been reconquered. Economy is functional again, food growth stable, political situation balanced. Strong cooperation between races. Population numbers back to around 60% of pre-invasion values.

## E64 - Crimson Covenant Plans Continue
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Covenant
- **Description**: The Crimson Covenant keeps pushing for the recapturing of Balor to fuse him with Khar'Zul, control Khar'Zul reincarnated to obtain the currency, magical items, and artifacts needed to bring back a version of B strong enough to destroy the Gods and get rid of the celestial dictatorship.

## E65 - Gods' Ongoing Plan
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Divine Scheme
- **Description**: The Gods' plans are an intricate mess: destroy the Crimson Covenant, grow more powerful from mortals' worship, and stop the resurrection of B.
## E76 - Nyra Seeks Adventurers
- **Year**: 500
- **Visibility**: [SECRET]
- **Category**: Quest
- **Description**: Nyra, now 20, seeks adventurers to help collect the remaining three elemental soul crystals (Fire, Water, Earth) and find her parents -- who she believes are captured, not dead.
